evidence_camera.name: 48MP USB Camera
evidence_camera.colour_use: coarse controller-local relative screening only until lighting and colour-card geometry are controlled

software_pipeline.input: controller/profile/target/recipe/replica bound Lab measurements plus single-pixel-purity and boundary gates
software_pipeline.output: controller-local coarse lightness candidate pairs; qualified count remains zero
software_pipeline.fail_closed: Never pool CS1/CS2 or LUT profiles; reject spatial impurity, dirty boundaries, insufficient replicas, position instability, inadequate L* separation, or hue drift.

software_pipeline.input: exact G3 or G4 action, live-synchronized 48MP capture sidecar, bound JPEG, and either direct V3 geometry or an exactly compatible sealed Latin V3 homography
software_pipeline.output: 128-cell Lab and four-edge observations plus sixteen recipes times four replicas screened independently on each controller
software_pipeline.fail_closed: Reject the binocular camera, changed camera instance/backend/mount/resolution/settings, insufficient visible geometry, action/JPEG/hash drift, controller pooling, or any automatic qualification claim.

software_pipeline.input: exact candidate fingerprints plus independent reproducibility, local-HOLD, white-recovery, and cross-profile evidence
software_pipeline.output: controller-specific qualified recipes only after every selected reproducibility gate passes
software_pipeline.fail_closed: History-conditioned lightness requires fresh-white reconstruction; an in-place identical-target repeat cannot substitute for it.

software_pipeline.input: exact L3 analysis and exact L3/L4 same-exposure comparison
software_pipeline.output: HOLD, independent white baseline, fresh reconstruction, and final white plan
software_pipeline.fail_closed: No shortlist auto-promotion, no in-place target repeat after HOLD, no hardware authorization or autochain.

software_pipeline.input: exact F1 G3 T0 and candidate-HOLD H1/H2 T1/T2 analyses, actions, captures, JPEGs, camera lock, and probe geometry
software_pipeline.output: controller-local candidate retention, H1 retention, H2 appearance, edge-purity, same-profile HOLD, and directional cross-LUT review drafts
software_pipeline.fail_closed: Reject identity/camera/geometry/visible-cell drift, controller pooling, spatial dithering, incomplete four-replica recipes, missing probes, dirty edges, overwrite, or any automatic passed palette evidence.

software_pipeline.input: two different fresh-white construction campaigns with byte-identical G1/G2/G3 optical payload identities and exactly comparable 48MP analyses
software_pipeline.output: controller-local per-cell and per-recipe fresh-reconstruction review plus non-qualifying evidence drafts
software_pipeline.fail_closed: Reject same action reuse, payload drift, camera/settings/geometry drift, unequal visible-cell sets, controller pooling, or recipes lacking all four visible replicas; qualified counts remain zero.

software_pipeline.input: controller-specific stable endpoint evidence and one exact source-middle-target lightness mechanism, plus ordered gate evidence
software_pipeline.output: position-balanced C0..C7 family batches with four replicas per recipe and independently admitted ready-family subsets
software_pipeline.fail_closed: Reject controller/profile/code mismatch, spatial dithering, skipped gates, reused evidence, or unproven mechanisms; unready families are excluded rather than inferred.

software_pipeline.input: qualified controller-specific recipes and qualified per-profile HOLD capabilities
software_pipeline.output: source/middle/target passes ordered by LUT profile with HOLD codes outside the active profile
software_pipeline.fail_closed: Reject candidate recipes, controller mismatch, unqualified HOLD/recovery/reconstruction, incomplete profile order, or a later profile unable to retain every earlier profile.

software_pipeline.output: per-pixel recipe assignment and multi-LUT execution schedule
software_pipeline.fail_closed: Spatial dithering is not accepted as colour evidence or as a substitute for a qualified single-pixel palette slot.

software_pipeline.input: one sealed MultiLutHoldSchedule plus sealed source-white authority and an explicit independent-white-successor requirement
software_pipeline.output: fixed packed-frame binaries, manual one-shot action identities, codegen metadata, canonical manifest, and SHA256SUMS
software_pipeline.fail_closed: Reject any schedule/frame/mask/profile/order drift, unready recipe, missing source-white authority, runtime raw frame or dynamic payload ingress, overwrite, or implied live authority.

software_pipeline.input: one integrity-verified stable-base lightness-family plan plus distinct sealed downstream artifact hashes
software_pipeline.output: deterministic next-function gate, admitted ready-family subset, blocked downstream stages, and deferred hue/reliability status
software_pipeline.fail_closed: Reject skipped dependencies, zero-ready-family photo artifacts, artifact hash reuse, tampered family plans, hardware actions, or automatic colour qualification; one ready family unlocks only its limited subset.

lightness_mechanism_paths.decision: Keep only controller-local, recipe-following, position-repeatable single-pixel differences.
Construct once, then avoid rewriting candidate pixels while known compatible LUT probes update outside regions.
Rebuild the complete source-middle-target recipe from an independent white anchor at least twice.
Use paired known-compatible profiles only after endpoint hue and lightness are separately measured.
Permit only bounded derivatives of parsed compatible profiles with fixture and polarity checks; no unknown register or LUT command sweep.
Use only after lower-risk function paths fail, with independent cutoff hardware and factory-white containment.

stages.name: factory_otp_white_baseline_and_containment
stages.claim_boundary: No obvious prior grid, colour stain, gross stripe, or centre-seam defect; absolute white point and precision uniformity are not proven.

stages.name: position_balanced_gray_lightness_mechanism
stages.objective: Determine whether 16 balanced history recipes produce spatially repeatable neutral or same-hue lightness-separated single-pixel states.

stages.name: stable_base_hue_lightness_latin_screen
stages.objective: Characterize whether a fixed stable target hue retains history-dependent lightness after an identical target refresh.

stages.name: fresh_white_reconstruction_reproducibility
stages.objective: Prove a history-conditioned recipe by rebuilding it from independent factory-white anchors rather than overwriting the original pixels.
stages.remaining_gate: HOLD-white live COMPLETE/claim/OFF/clean-white, first G3 evidence, reconstruction R3 COMPLETE, and same-geometry same-settings camera comparison.

stages.name: local_hold_cross_lut_coexistence
stages.objective: Preserve already written regions while a later compatible LUT updates selected pixels or regions.
stages.known_positive_evidence: Black, blue, and green local regions accumulated without visible refresh of retained regions in corrected geometry trials.
stages.clean_transport: full-C7 preload, one inclusive PTLW per controller, cropped DTM, PON/DRF00/POF00
stages.remaining_gate: Create exact F1 G3 COMPLETE with no G4 result, then bind T0/T1/T2 controller-local HOLD and directional cross-LUT review evidence.

stages.name: stable_base_hue_lightness_family_generalization
stages.objective: Apply one proven source-middle-target lightness mechanism to existing stable hue endpoints, producing controller-specific light/mid/dark families before enumerating additional hues.

stages.name: usable_palette_model
stages.objective: Represent each usable colour as a controller-specific source, middle, target, reproducibility mode, LUT profile, and local-HOLD sequence.

stages.name: static_photo_pixel_mapping
stages.objective: Map photograph pixels to qualified controller-specific palette recipes without spatial dithering, then schedule grouped local refreshes by LUT profile.
stages.fail_closed_behavior: Reject candidate recipes, controller-half mismatch, unqualified HOLD or reconstruction, incomplete profile order, and any later LUT not proven to retain every earlier profile.

stages.name: fixed_static_photo_execution_campaign
stages.objective: Convert one sealed multi-LUT photo schedule into fixed compile-time frames and explicit one-shot actions with an independently bound factory-white successor.

coarse_screening_gates.controller_rule: CS1 and CS2 are independent physical colour systems; cross-controller differences are never counted as lightness levels or replicas.
coarse_screening_gates.qualification_authority: No camera analysis or firmware action automatically grants a qualified colour.

execution_safety.source_gate: V3 white successor COMPLETE plus exact 48MP clean-white review and relay-OFF evidence
execution_safety.next_live_successor: F1 LUMA_GRAY_MECHANISM_POSITION_BALANCED_V3; offline independent audit and its own white successor are complete
execution_safety.sequential_test_policy: Every mutating branch ends in its independently bound factory-OTP white containment before another branch is rebound.
